title: Red or Green?
can_do: 在两个选项之间比较（味道、大小），说出选择的理由。

conversation_move.label: compare two options and choose with a reason

trigger: Two kinds of apples are offered and Child does not yet know the difference, so he asks and compares.
setting: Grocery day at the kitchen counter.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Red apples or green apples today?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Green ones are sour, red ones are sweet.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I want red ones because I like sweet things.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: The red ones are a little smaller though.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: That's okay. Small apples fit my hands.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Then red it is. Grab four, please.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Four red apples, one for each of us and Max.

replay_cards.title: Two kinds of bread
replay_cards.setting: Bakery counter with a round loaf and a long loaf.
replay_cards.change: Child must choose one for the family.
replay_cards.challenge: Child compares the soft round one and the crunchy long one, and picks with a reason.

replay_cards.title: Rain boots
replay_cards.setting: Store shelf with red and yellow boots.
replay_cards.challenge: Child compares and chooses with a reason, and accepts Mom's reminder about which color shows mud less.

parent_support: 给两个真实选项，先等孩子问区别再解释。
孩子只说“我要这个”时，追问一句“为什么选它”，逼出理由。
接受孩子气的原因（“小的拿得稳”），这就是比较思维的起点。
